derivation: from H7378 (רִיב) and H1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); shame (i.e. the idol) will contend;
def: Jerubbesheth, a symbolic name for Gideon

occurrences.text: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
